name: pilot
note: Tests whether 3D69 changes the pilot's machine or puts the pilot into a different mode. The lead: five actors own a unit entry named after the actor themselves rather than a mecha, and two of them — アルベルト (unit 211 beside mecha 170) and シュバルツ (unit 362 beside mecha 0) — appear in the 3D69 instance list. If 3D69 swaps a pilot between those two entries, the unit-instance id under the roster slot changes, exactly the way 3D50 was confirmed. Each actor is deployed in the mecha form and the roster slot's unit pointer and unit id are read from the per-command state captures before and after, so the answer does not depend on reading the picture. 豹馬 repeats the combine-1 negative as a control.
